name: Research Society on Alcohol Annual Scientific Meeting 2027
description: The Research Society on Alcohol, formerly the Research Society on Alcoholism, holds an annual scientific meeting on alcohol research, addiction medicine, and neuroscience. Exact dates, city, and venue for the 2027 meeting have not yet been published by the organizer as of September 2026.
